# Job 16 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** Job 16 (22 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 3

---

## V.19 — "witness/advocate" rendering
- **EMET:** "my-witness / my-advocate" / **LOGOS:** "my witness / he who testifies for me" / **PNEUMA:** "a witness / someone on high"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "my witness is in heaven, and he who testifies for me is on high" — preserves the formal legal parallelism of the Hebrew.

---

## V.20 — meilitsai/litsei wordplay
- **EMET:** "my-friends are my-scorners" / **LOGOS:** "my friends scorn me" / **PNEUMA:** "my so-called friends mock me"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "My friends scorn me" — captures the reversal economically since the Hebrew wordplay cannot be reproduced in English.

---

## V.21 — "argue the case" vs. "plead"
- **LOGOS:** "argue the case" / **PNEUMA:** "plead my case"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** Combines both: "argue the case... as a son of man pleads with his neighbor" — mirrors the Hebrew movement from confrontation to entreaty.

---
*— SOPHIA*
